svg.title: Binance BTC/ETH/SOL rolling 1h Diff
svg.desc: Diff is UpCount minus DownCount over the latest twelve 5-minute Binance candles. Global min and max are marked for each asset.
svg.text: Binance 5m Rolling 1h Diff: BTC, ETH, SOL
Window: latest 12 candles = 1 hour. Full windows only. Period: 2025-12-28 09:24 UTC to 2026-06-28 08:29 UTC.
